description: Return the public holidays for a country and calendar year, with each holiday's date, name and type. Names are returned in English wherever the country publishes it; pass a language code for others (Kenya also publishes Swahili).

country.description: ISO-2 country code, e.g. NG, KE, GH, ZA.

lang.description: Optional language code for holiday names, e.g. 'sw' for Swahili.

name: get_public_holidays
title: Get public holidays for an African country and year
